$comment: Commands only rusthrc implements (no Bun CLI exists for them). generate-surface.ts grafts each node under its parent and adds the parent's Commands line; differential.py has no Bun oracle for them.

commandLine: list, put, delete, or act on seat and generation annotations

node.name: annotation
node.help:
Usage: hrc session annotation [options] [command]

list, put, delete, or act on seat and generation annotations

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  list [options] <target>    list annotations on a continuity
  put [options] <target>     create or replace one annotation
  delete [options] <target>  delete one annotation
  act [options] <target>     record an action on an existing annotation
  help [command]             display help for command

children.name: list

children.name: put
children.help:
Usage: hrc session annotation put [options] <target>

create or replace one annotation

Options:
  --ns <ns>                   annotation namespace
  --kind <kind>               annotation kind
  --id <id>                   annotation id
  --subject <subject>         seat (default) or generation
  --generation <n>            the generation, for --subject generation
  --body-file <path>          JSON object body; - reads stdin
  --expect-generation <n>     refuse stale_generation unless the active generation is n
  --expect-attention-at <ts>  refuse stale_attention unless live attention is at ts
  --expect-updated-at <ts>    refuse stale_annotation unless the annotation's updatedAt is ts (null: must not exist)
  --as <principal>            the request principal, recorded as updatedBy (default unknown)
  --json                      output as JSON
  -h, --help                  display help for command

commandLine: mark-gated prune of runtimes past the window

node.name: prune-window
node.help:
Usage: hrc runtime prune-window [options]

delete terminal runtimes past the retention window, with their ledgers, behind
the lake's prune mark (state dir prune-mark.json); previews unless --yes

Options:
  --window <duration>  retention window, e.g. 14d (default: the daemon's
                       HRC_RUNTIME_PRUNE_WINDOW; unset deletes nothing)
  --max-minutes <n>    stop after n minutes (default: 25)
  --dry-run            report what would be deleted without deleting
  --yes                confirm deletion
  --json               output the full report as JSON
  -h, --help           display help for command

  --ndjson            output one NDJSON object per row

commandLine: search completed transcript turns across runtimes with the resident BM25 index

node.name: search
node.help:
Usage: hrc monitor search [options] <query>

search completed transcript turns across runtimes with the resident BM25 index

Arguments:
  query                      bare words (implicit AND) or a double-quoted phrase

Options:
  --agent <agent>            filter by exact agent ID
  --project <project>        filter by exact project ID
  --task <task>              filter by exact task ID
  --target <target>          handle, scope, runtime, or invocation target
  --since <duration-or-iso>  lower completion-time bound
  --until <iso>              upper completion-time bound
  --limit <n>                maximum runtime groups or within-runtime hits
                             (default: "20")
  --candidate-limit <n>      bounded discovery candidates before aggregation
                             (default: "300")
  --json                     output the full pointer tuples and index stats as
                             JSON
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Example: hrc monitor search "deployment failed" --project hrc-runtime --limit 10
